resolved_by: Guidelines Amendment 795 (USSG App. C), which added § 4A1.2 cmt. n.3(A) to respond to the circuit conflict
issue: Whether a prior sentence treated as part of a single sentence under the Guidelines' single-sentence rule can serve as a predicate offense for a Guidelines enhancement.
quote: respond[] to a circuit conflict regarding the meaning of the ‘single sentence’ rule . . . and its implications for the career offender guideline and other guidelines that provide sentencing enhancements for predicate offenses.
cite: United States v. Silva, 981 F.3d 794 (10th Cir. 2020)
